ordering-fifo.why: SNS FIFO topic and SQS FIFO queue are used, and api.py sets MessageGroupId=str(o["customer_id"]).

dlq-5.why: orders_worker has a redrive_policy to the FIFO orders_dlq with maxReceiveCount = 5.

visibility-timeout.why: visibility_timeout_seconds = 540 equals the Lambda timeout of 540.

run-timeout-900.why: The API runs on ECS Fargate behind an ALB with idle_timeout = 900.

presign-expiry.why: The summary flags that 7-day presigned URLs will expire within hours under task-role credentials.

rds-iam-auth.why: aws_db_instance sets engine_version 15, iam_database_authentication_enabled = true, multi_az = true and backup_retention_period = 7.

worker-event-shape.why: worker.py reads event["Records"][].body, and the SNS subscription uses raw_message_delivery = true so the body is the order JSON.

sql-dialect.why: The SQL uses TRY_CAST, a ROW_NUMBER subquery instead of QUALIFY, partition_date (flagged as an assumption) and SLICE(ARRAY_AGG(ROW(...) ORDER BY ...),1,3).

lifecycle.why: Versioning is enabled, with a 30-day transition to STANDARD_IA and expiration at 365 days.

multi-region-flag.why: Everything is mapped to the single region us-east-2, but neither the code nor the summary flags the loss of US multi-region durability/availability for GCS or BigQuery.

no-silent-changes.why: Some changes are not called out: the lifecycle noncurrent-version handling, the autoscaling policy (80 requests per target is not the same as concurrency 80), the desired_count ignore_changes, SNS dedup via uuid, and the added API key and 0.0.0.0/0 ingress; the summary covers many other changes but not all of these.
